title: WP4/WP5 TOPO-2D-00 RANS results interchange (draft, not a scientific freeze)
description: All forces are dimensionless centre-section coefficients on common c1=223.4 mm, drag=+Cx and downforce=-Cz. Sharp-arm force records carry observable=pressure_cl for Cp comparison; thick-arm records carry observable=total_cl for WaterLily comparison. Differencing across observables is forbidden. Every physical height reports h/c1 and h/c (c=380 mm). Eight paired realisations per model/family are required; repeated mesh SHA-256 make that arm DEGENERATE_REALISATIONS with point estimate only, no interval and an INCOMPLETE ratio test. Published finite trailing edges remain in E*_sharp. NUMERICAL, MESH_FAILED and INCOMPLETE remain distinct outcomes, never zero force.

h_over_c1.description: Same physical height_mm divided by 223.4 mm; the consumer validates consistency.

h_over_c.description: Same physical height_mm divided by 380 mm; the consumer validates consistency.

delta_cl.description: Measured centre-section E2_original minus E1_original downforce coefficient, both re-normalized on c1. Positive downforce convention.

digitizing_uncertainty.description: Absolute double-element Cp-integral uncertainty, conservatively summed over elements as abs(reading1-reading2), per registration Amendment 1 section 6. The two digitization files must have different SHA-256 content. If greater than 0.05*abs(delta_cl), TR-00 uses sign-only; equality uses the ratio rule.

source.description: Required for formal CLI analysis, optional only in synthetic API fixtures. Record both single-element Table 15/Cl(h) extraction and double-element Cp integration in method/pages, use the centre-section observable, and provide at least two independently obtained digitization artifacts. Every artifact path and SHA must be bound by the study freeze input inventory.

path.description: Distinct artifact path, repository-relative or absolute; must appear in the study freeze inputs.

method.description: Independent person/tool and extraction/integration method; distinct files alone do not prove methodological independence.

provenance.description: OPTIONAL only for synthetic numerical API fixtures. REQUIRED for a formal CLI dataset: geometry_sha256 must contain exactly E1,E2,E3,E1_sharp,E2_sharp and equal the parent-owned study freeze's geometry_sha256 map of main-grid/unthickened-original JSON file hashes. The actual scene JSON files must also appear in that freeze input inventory. WP5 records actual source/runtime/freeze identities here; the study freeze binds this entire JSON by SHA-256. Confirmation-grid geometry is separately bound by its harness campaign; it is not substituted for the main RANS geometry.

realisation.description: SETTLED requires a non-null finite force and non-null mesh SHA for that config. The Python consumer enforces this cross-field rule and unique IDs; null is allowed only for failed/unattempted configs. Pair all configurations by id, not by accidental array order. Eight mesh SHA values must be distinct for each configuration across the cell. Duplicate SHA values preserve point diagnostics but cannot yield an interval.

cell_summary.description: Optional collector diagnostics. The analyzer independently recomputes mesh identities and point estimates.

thickening_alone.description: Optional collector summaries. The analyzer recomputes same-observable differences from realisation.diagnostics, never from these summaries.

thickening_difference.description: Descriptive thick minus original at one identical observable on both arms; no study label. Collector emits point estimates only. Independent analyzer/checker use raw per-realisation coefficients and observable-specific convergence.
